summary.text: On Ixalan, the golden city of Orazca rises from the valley, and Kumena, Vona's Legion of Dusk, Huatli and the River Heralds all struggle to claim the Immortal Sun, the greatest power of the plane.

Jace and Vraska, working together after Jace's memories are shaken loose, learn that the sphinx Azor made the Sun to imprison Nicol Bolas at the cost of his own spark, and that Bolas wants it for his army of Eternals.
Vraska calls Tezzeret to carry the Immortal Sun off the plane as part of a secret plan to betray Bolas, leaving the people of Ixalan free to decide Orazca's future.
